notes: AJA GEN10 is an HD/SD/AES tri-level sync (genlock) generator with 7 BNC outputs (6 video sync BNCs in two independently switchable groups of 4 and 2, plus 1 AES-11 BNC) and one DC barrel power input. All video outputs are analog tri-level HD sync or SD color-black/bars, not digital SDI data streams, so SDI bandwidth grades were intentionally omitted (device carries no video payload, only sync/reference). Confirmed against AJA's official spec sheet (aja.com/products/gen10/spec-sheet.pdf) and official Installation & Operation Guide, which includes an annotated connector-panel photo and an explicit connector count in Appendix A: Specifications ("Video Sync Outputs: 4 BNCs-Outputs 1 through 4; 2 BNCs-Outputs 5 and 6"; "AES-11 Output: ...1 BNC"; "Power: Uses AJA Power Supply model DWP-U-R1... +5V DC regulated"). Desktop mini-converter form factor (5.8 x 3.1 x 1.0 in), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. Categorized as converter/Converter since no better-fitting category/type exists in the allowed list for a standalone sync generator.
